import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
point = ee.Geometry.Point([-87.160422, 56.271030])
roi = point.buffer(10000)  # 10km radius buffer

date1_start = '2020-07-12'
date1_end = '2020-07-14'
date2_start = '2020-07-28'
date2_end = '2020-07-30'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloudBitMask = 1 << 10
    cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(mask)

col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(roi) \
    .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(roi) \
    .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"July 13 images: {size1}, July 29 images: {size2}")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("Trying Landsat 8...")
    col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end)
    col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end)
    size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
    size2 = col2.size().getInfo()
    print(f"Landsat - July 13: {size1}, July 29: {size2}")
    
if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) for ice detection
    # NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR)
    # Higher NDSI indicates ice/snow
    
    img1 = col1.mosaic()
    img2 = col2.mosaic()
    
    # For Sentinel-2: Green=B3, SWIR=B11
    ndsi1 = img1.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('ndsi')
    ndsi2 = img2.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('ndsi')
    
    # Check valid pixels
    count1 = ndsi1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ndsi').getInfo()
    
    count2 = ndsi2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('ndsi').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Valid pixels - July 13: {count1}, July 29: {count2}")
    
    if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean NDSI and ice coverage (NDSI > 0.4 typically indicates ice)
        ice_threshold = 0.4
        
        ice1 = ndsi1.gt(ice_threshold)
        ice2 = ndsi2.gt(ice_threshold)
        
        ice_pixels1 = ice1.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=roi,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('ndsi').getInfo()
        
        ice_pixels2 = ice2.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=roi,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('ndsi').getInfo()
        
        mean_ndsi1 = ndsi1.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=roi,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('ndsi').getInfo()
        
        mean_ndsi2 = ndsi2.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=roi,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('ndsi').getInfo()
        
        print(f"July 13: NDSI={mean_ndsi1:.3f}, Ice pixels={ice_pixels1}")
        print(f"July 29: NDSI={mean_ndsi2:.3f}, Ice pixels={ice_pixels2}")
        
        if ice_pixels1 is None or ice_pixels2 is None or mean_ndsi1 is None or mean_ndsi2 is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif ice_pixels2 > ice_pixels1:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
